title: GSX-401FW STARGAZER GUNDAM (ETERNAL STAR GLORY)
summary: This Chinese brand's kit is surprisingly satisfied to assemble.
body: This Chinese brand's kit is surprisingly satisfied to assemble.
The quality of the plastic is no joke, it can hold a candle to Bandai average modern MGs and many of them has colored coat on. Except the bonus parts which have poor quality (for being... free?).

The joints are tight, you could post a fly away pose or floating in the air with no problems. It's easy. Just don't do the box art pose because the legs can't be positioned like that, especially with the base.
The best thing of this GLORY is its simplicity. Probably a nod to every Bandai lovers out there that Bandai still does it best in design and if you follow them, you have a quality kit.
I have been asking for Stargazer MG kits but Bandai doesn't care. Hopefully they would do more Bandai design kits with the same quality, probably Lunagazer?
